Tapping into your mood, identifying how you feel, and making positive lifestyle changes is the most effective way of learning to cope with daily stress. Mood Balance is the perfect mood tracker to help you achieve this as it allows you to define, record, and explore your various moods. By doing so, you'll discover a host of stats, activities, and games all professionally designed to benefit your mental health.

Mood Balance helps you achieve relaxation through querying your feelings, their causes, and the resultant negative moods you may be experiencing. It then presents a collection of stats and stress relief games to help you understand and manage each. See Mood Balance as an emotion tracker that speaks back, or a diary that listens to your thoughts and offers genuine solutions to help beat depression and anxiety.

To activate your mood tracker, start by simply selecting how you're feeling, ranging from any emotion that matches you. Next, define the reason for this mood and save it, detailing the date and time. Now, the tracking begins. This mood tracker instantly keeps a record and starts building your personalized relief journal to provide an accurate breakdown of your mental health. You can explore weekly mood ratings, discover how often your moods change, follow your top moods, and identify the activities that cause emotional shifts. 

Next, you can start exploring an extensive collection of relaxing games designed to challenge and soothe different negative emotions. Each unique game promotes instant and effective relief while remaining entirely accessible and customizable. As you play, you can explore easy to grasp mechanics as well as a wealth of additional features to fine-tune your relaxation.

Mood Balance is the mood tracker that works with you. It does so to promote anxiety relief while guiding you to understand and forge new, more healthy habits. Download Mood Balance, start building your relaxation calendar, and become the boss of your mental health today.

A daily-use self-care app featuring encouragement, journaling, and mood tracking. Explore and reflect on how you’re feeling and what you’re facing through journaling with unique writing prompts, recording your emotions, and receiving encouragement and inspirational quotes that you can share on social media. The app also features curated blog posts and podcast episodes by To Write Love on Her Arms, which cover a variety of mental health topics such as depression, anxiety, addiction, living with diagnoses, healing trauma, and more.

Self-care, awareness, and connection are at the forefront of The Hopeful. We believe in talking about and addressing the hard things—while believing that better days are possible. Regardless of how you choose to use The Hopeful, know that your story is important and hope exists.

To Write Love On Her Arms is a non-profit movement dedicated to presenting hope and finding help for people struggling with depression, addiction, self-injury, and suicide. TWLOHA exists to encourage, inform, inspire, and also to invest directly into treatment and recovery.

results.description:
Caring for someone who lives alone means a constant low-level worry: are they okay today? TapSure Care turns that worry into a simple daily answer.

You set up a check-in. At the time you choose, we text your loved one. They reply YES if all is well, or HELP if they need you. If nothing comes back, you get an alert. They never need to install anything — it works over ordinary text messages, on whatever phone they already have.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Add a loved one — their name, mobile number, and an optional backup contact.
2. Create a check-in — choose the type, the time, how often it repeats, and their country and time zone.
3. At the scheduled time they receive a text, and reply YES or HELP.
4. You see the outcome on your home screen. No reply, and you're alerted.

CHECK-IN TYPES

• Wellness — a simple "are you doing okay?"
• Medication — a reminder at the time it's due
• Meal — a nudge around mealtimes
• Custom — write your own message, in your own words

SCHEDULING

• Repeat daily, on weekdays, on weekends, weekly, or monthly
• Set the time in your loved one's own country and time zone
• Daylight saving is handled for you — 9am stays 9am
• Run more than one check-in a day for the same person

STAYING INFORMED

• Push and email alerts when someone doesn't respond, or asks for help
• A home screen showing at a glance who has replied and who hasn't
• Full check-in history, so you can see patterns over time
• An optional backup contact, tried if the first number can't be reached
• Manage several loved ones from one place

WHO IT'S FOR

• Adult children checking in on ageing parents
• Families living in different cities or countries
• Anyone supporting a person who lives alone
• People who live alone and want someone to know they're okay

ABOUT THE TEXT MESSAGES

Before anyone receives recurring check-ins, they confirm from their own phone by replying YES. They can reply STOP at any time to stop the messages, or HELP for support. How often messages arrive depends on the schedule you set. Message and data rates may apply.

Phone numbers are used only to send check-ins and related notifications. We do not sell your information, and we never share mobile numbers with third parties for marketing.

PLEASE NOTE

TapSure Care is a wellbeing check-in tool. It is not an emergency service, a medical device, or a monitoring system. It does not contact emergency services, track health, or provide medical advice. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Check-ins depend on mobile networks and can be delayed or fail to arrive. Please don't rely on TapSure Care as your only way of knowing that someone is safe.

SUPPORT
